authority: V8.3.203 FORENSIC OF V8.3.202 SEALED BATCH A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

groups.cause: V71 clarification lexicon recognizes earlier ownership-missing formulations but misses settled-account plus unassigned/unidentified/not-established closing-response variants.
groups.bounded_fix: Require completed-account cue + self-attributed final-response/move cue + explicit unresolved attribution cue.

groups.cause: V71 decision detector is narrower than take-over-the-decision / option-becomes-my-answer phrasing.
groups.bounded_fix: Require takeover imperative + decision/option object + direct answer/instruction cue.

groups.cause: Constructed-example + classification-testing + never-happened wording falls outside prior fictional/fabricated markers.
groups.bounded_fix: Require constructed/example marker + testing/classification purpose + explicit non-lived marker.

groups.cause: Unspoken judgement / colleague / beyond visible behaviour is semantically equivalent to existing hidden-state contract but lexically uncovered.
groups.bounded_fix: Require hidden/unspoken internal-state cue + third-party person cue + about-user cue + non-observable qualifier.

groups.cause: Ultimately turn out well + before month end is outside V71 future-positive phrase set.
groups.bounded_fix: Require future/outcome construction + positive-result cue + future horizon cue.

groups.cause: V71 freeze detector misses starter experiment / widening option set / collecting possibilities / expanding comparison variants; S035 also loses precedence to ignore-like parent behavior.
groups.bounded_fix: Require reversible/easy-to-undo action + option-expansion cue + delay/non-start cue; evaluate before ignore.

groups.cause: Important issue + required action + redirected attention + lower-priority task is outside existing central-task/peripheral wording.
groups.bounded_fix: Require important/main matter + action-required cue + diversion cue + lower-priority/peripheral target.

groups.cause: Later-than-usual / took-longer + one check + closure is not recognized by V71 slow detector and parent ignore classification wins.
groups.bounded_fix: Require delayed-response cue + single-check cue + closure cue; evaluate before ignore.

groups.cause: Backed-away / same-review / fresh-information variant misses V71 sequence cue set.
groups.bounded_fix: Require approach + retreat + return-to-same-review + repetition/no-new-information cues.

change_control.engine_layer: bounded lexical/compositional routing and family discrimination only
